edit_types.label: Split screen: media above
edit_types.desc: Supporting image or video above the speaker.

edit_types.label: Split screen: media below
edit_types.desc: Speaker above supporting image or video.

edit_types.label: Green screen
edit_types.desc: Cut out the speaker over supporting images or video, without a split screen.

caption_styles.label: Impact
caption_styles.desc: Tall condensed lettering with a dark outline. The spoken word lights up and each phrase enters with a small bounce.

caption_styles.label: Word box
caption_styles.desc: A colored box follows the spoken word.

caption_styles.label: Giant word
caption_styles.desc: One oversized word at a time with a dimensional accent shadow.

caption_styles.label: Pulse
caption_styles.desc: Bold round lettering; the spoken word grows and changes color.

caption_styles.label: Tape
caption_styles.desc: A slightly tilted dark tape opens from the left; the spoken word uses the accent color.

caption_styles.label: Clean captions
caption_styles.desc: A complete phrase over a translucent dark background, in at most two lines, without animation.

caption_styles.label: Paper
caption_styles.desc: Words appear progressively with a dark outline; the current word grows and uses the accent color.

caption_styles.label: Paper on light background
caption_styles.desc: Dark lettering and a white halo remain readable over light graphics.

caption_styles.label: Testimonial
caption_styles.desc: The phrase uses the accent color and the currently spoken word becomes white.

hook_styles.label: Headline
hook_styles.desc: A large condensed title with a dark outline and an accented second line.

hook_styles.label: Banners
hook_styles.desc: Each line uses a solid, slightly tilted banner.

hook_styles.label: Speech bubble
hook_styles.desc: A white speech bubble with dark lettering.

hook_styles.label: Marker
hook_styles.desc: Brush lettering over colored marker strokes.

hook_styles.label: Dark glass
hook_styles.desc: A translucent dark panel with white text and an accent detail.

hook_markup: Words between asterisks use the accent color: "Keep *complete words* audible". A highlighted word is colored as a whole. Use \* for a literal asterisk. CTA and disclaimer text do not use this markup. Unsupported emoji and glyphs are removed.
